_approach: Shaker-and-hat density lift into the drop: the syncopated offbeat hats and shaker bed thicken from sparse 8ths to a full swung 16th lattice while the tresillo cowbell accelerates underneath, the kick staying 4x4 in bar 1 and thinning to just the downbeat in bar 2 so the open-hat choke and a final crash own the peak. Ref: the genre's rule that hats never carpet a flat 16th (Melodigging), EDMProd's guide to build-up density lifts. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
